minutes.headline: Planning Board endorsed two ANR plans and accepted a subdivision withdrawal; Zoom failed again, so other items were deferred.
minutes.summary: The Planning Board met without Zoom for the second meeting in a row and without its land use contractor in the room. It endorsed ANR plans for Flynn Road and 728 Goodrich Street and accepted withdrawal of the 171 Arbor Street definitive plan without prejudice. It continued the 255 Sunny Hill Road hearing to January 22. A common driveway request for 728 Goodrich could not be discussed because it was not on the agenda.

attendees.role: land use contractor, watching by Facebook Live and texting input
presenter (Dillis and Roy Civil Design Group, for the Flynn Road applicants)

public_comment.topic: Chair asked for public comment at the start. A person said they were there for the hearing, so no comment was given.
Public comment was offered at the end; no public was in the room.

votes.motion: Endorse the ANR for Flynn Road as presented.
Endorse the ANR for 728 Goodrich Street.
Accept withdrawal of the 171 Arbor Street definitive subdivision plan without prejudice.
Continue the 255 Sunny Hill Road stormwater management plan public hearing to January 22 at 6:05 p.m.

budget_items.what_was_said: A member said state and federal matching grants are available, and cited a pending 40B project's cost to illustrate potential savings. He urged the board to look at large parcels for senior housing.

decisions.decision: The common driveway request for 728 Goodrich Street will be put on the next meeting agenda. It was not discussed because it was not on tonight's agenda.
The erosion control plan revision for 274 Prospect Street was passed over because no one was present, and it will be pushed to a later meeting.
Committee reports were deferred until Zoom is available. The board will add the solar bylaw and scenic road ad hoc subcommittees to a future agenda.
The chair will not open a future meeting if Zoom is on the agenda and does not work. The next meetings are January 22 and February 12.
A letter from a resident on the scenic road conversation will be read into the record at the next televised meeting.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board endorsed the Flynn Road ANR plan, a land swap for a shed, by voice vote.
The board endorsed the ANR plan for 728 Goodrich Street by voice vote.
The board accepted withdrawal of the 171 Arbor Street definitive subdivision plan without prejudice, by voice vote.
The 255 Sunny Hill Road stormwater management hearing was continued to January 22 at 6:05 p.m.
Zoom failed again, so committee reports were deferred and the chair said no future meeting will open if Zoom is on the agenda and does not work.

why_it_matters: Two small lot-line plans moved forward and one subdivision proposal ended, but the Sunny Hill Road stormwater hearing is still open, so neighbors can still be heard on it.

With Zoom down for a second meeting, residents who rely on remote access could not follow the meeting live, and the common driveway request for 728 Goodrich was not discussed because it was not on the agenda.
